authoredNote: Transcribed from a measured run against this file. The DECLARING half of the two-file local-read fixture; see `reads.expectation.json` for the property the pair exists for.
rationale: Exists so the collision is REAL rather than hypothetical. Its content is deliberately the most ordinary shape available — two classes, two fields, common English names — because the defect needed no unusual input: it needed only that some declaration in the project carry the local's name exactly once. Under the bare-name rule that was the entire requirement for the store to bind a function's own `$counter` to `Telemetry::$counter`, a field of a class in a file the reader never names. `reads.expectation.json`'s forbid rows are statements about THIS file's declarations.
